narrative.overview: MinFinder is a map you carry into the backcountry, and the map is the screen. Controls float on it AllTrails-style (a white search pill and status chips on top, a gold Add a mine pill and white map buttons at the bottom) and bottom sheets rise over it to carry content. Everything off the map uses the same small kit in components/ui.tsx.
keyCharacteristics: Map-first: floating chrome, bottom sheets for content.
One gold pill per screen; the rest is white, lichen, ink.
One kit in components/ui.tsx; screens compose it.
Inter on a six-step type scale; tabular figures for readings.
Map chrome light in both schemes; compass dark in both.
Every sheet animates both ways; motion follows reduce-motion.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: At most one gold pill per screen or sheet. If two things are gold, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Legend Is Data Rule
rules.body: MINFILE status colours appear only on pins, badges, filter-chip dots and the About legend, always beside the status name.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from useColors(), MAP/DIAL or STATUS_MAP. Literals only in MapLibre layer styles and pin SVGs.

rules.name: The Instrument Reading Rule
rules.body: Every navigational number and price is set in tabular figures.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: floating means above something: map chrome, sheets, the selected segment. Never flat content.

rules.name: The Closing Rule
rules.body: Nothing that animates in may vanish on the way out: sheets take open plus useLast.

dos: Start from components/ui.tsx before writing styles.
Put content in a bottom sheet over the map, not a new full-screen form.
Use exactly one gold pill per screen.
Read MAP on the basemap and DIAL on the compass, whatever the scheme.
Set navigational numbers and prices in tabular figures.
Keep touch targets at 44pt or more; primary field actions toward 56pt.
Pair every status colour with its words.
donts: No font size, radius or colour outside type, radius and the tokens (no 9/10/11/13, no inline hex).
No government forms: long scrolls of fields and boilerplate.
No consumer-cute: pastel blobs, mascots, jokey copy.
No MINFILE status colours on buttons or chrome.
No floating shadow on flat content.
No centred RN Modal for new dialogs; use Sheet.
Nothing Pro in front of the paywall.
